Split into focused commits (docs; M0 benchmark; plan). Note: repo history mixes English-imperative and pt-BR conventional commit styles; CONTRIBUTING asks for English imperative.
acceptance_criteria: Working tree clean; fmt, clippy -D warnings and tests green.
close_reason: Committed in c261fee (spec and docs), 3fdf020 (M0), and the plan commit.

title: Housekeeping: land the 2.0 plan and keep the repo honest
description: Commit the 2.0 spec, the M0 work and the doc updates; settle the small decisions M0 left open.

title: Freeze `hapto: 2`, publish the schema, tag 2.0
acceptance_criteria: Format frozen; JSON Schema published; CHANGELOG; tag.

title: Error catalogue complete, every code tested
acceptance_criteria: Every code in §18.3 has a triggering test asserting code, path and hint; `hapto errors` prints all.

title: Browser matrix and reference-phone performance
description: Chromium/Firefox/WebKit at 1280/390 px, light/dark; real-device runs on Pixel 6a / iPhone 12 class; fix budget misses.
acceptance_criteria: p95 within §19.1 across the corpus, or documented exceptions carried by progressive quality.

title: Accessibility audit and axe-core in CI
acceptance_criteria: No level A/AA violations on the demo book; contrast checks (W402) in place.

title: Demo book with all 32 corpus figures
description: examples/book/ by domain; every binding verb, every task kind, a shared page value (b-phasor + b-unit-circle on theta), cross-refs of every kind; a second book.yaml with language: pt.
acceptance_criteria: `hapto book check` clean; built in CI.

title: book check: every build gate
description: All failures and warnings of §16.10 in one pass, with source positions; non-zero exit.
acceptance_criteria: A fixture book with one of each defect reports all of them.

title: Site output: pages, navigation, theme, i18n
description: index/cover with progress and resume, chapter pages, ToC sidebar/drawer with ticks, prev/next, theme toggle, book.css/book.js, strings table en + pt, relative links, assets copied.
acceptance_criteria: Book works from any static host; looked at on desktop and phone, light and dark.

title: Figures in the book: check, fallbacks, numbering, captions
description: Per figure: type-check, render light/dark at 720 px, ink gate (E601), invariants, bake maths, emit fallback SVGs, number and caption, inline the document in <hapto-figure>.
acceptance_criteria: A blank figure fails the build.

title: Bindings resolved and validated at build time
description: Resolution order page value → same section → chapter; E701 unresolved, E702 ambiguous (with candidates), E703 out-of-range set literal; W701 show text vs default readout; emit data-hapto-* attributes.
acceptance_criteria: Each error/warning tested on fixture chapters.

title: Prose maths as inline SVG
description: Typeset natively with kinemo-math (typeset feature), emit inline SVG with role=math, aria-label, vertical-align from baseline/depth; dedupe identical formulas; E606 with line.
acceptance_criteria: Inline maths sits on the baseline at several font sizes (looked at).

title: Markdown with hapto extensions
description: Pick the parser (comrak vs pulldown-cmark — decide here). CommonMark + tables/footnotes/strikethrough; front matter; $…$/$$…$$ with {#eq:}; ```hapto blocks and src=; [text]{verb …}; ::: when/note/…/task; @fig/@eq/@sec/@ch; {#sec:} anchors; [[glossary]].
acceptance_criteria: Every construct of §16.4 parsed with source positions; W401 on raw HTML.

title: hapto-book crate and book.yaml model
description: Source layout (§16.2), book.yaml model with schema (§16.3), `hapto book build|check|serve` command skeleton in the `hapto` binary.
acceptance_criteria: Schema published by `hapto schema --book`.

title: Preset framework and hapto expand
description: Named expansions into the base language; appended values/let/compute/marks/readouts; documented introduced names; `hapto expand`; a reference page per preset.
acceptance_criteria: expand(doc) re-parses and renders identically to the preset form.

title: Several views, phone stacking, connectors
description: layout grid with spans, widths/heights, phone stack/keep, per-view aspect; connector marks across views drawn above both.
acceptance_criteria: A unit circle + wave figure stacks correctly below 480 px.

title: heatmap as a raster underlay
description: Cell grid evaluation (4 px default, fixed colour range, diverging/sequential default, zero contour); native: bilinear upscale + composite in Rust; browser: worker posts the cell ImageBitmap, page draws it with drawImage + smoothing under a transparent main canvas; SVG embeds an <image>; one per view; marks below it → E609.
acceptance_criteria: Seamless (looked at); browser frame within the heavy budget in the M3 bench harness.

title: repeat on any mark
description: One or two bound variables over lists (product), counts following values, stable keys with indices, name[i] and shared group, 5 000 instance limit (E603 at check, truncate at runtime).
acceptance_criteria: Riemann rectangles with n from a slider; limit tested.

title: Invariant checks at check/build time
description: conserved/decreasing/any(+reason); checked at default state, range corners (≤64) and 16 seeded random states; violation E602 naming state, drift, method; W601 for unexplained euler; dev-mode runtime logging.
acceptance_criteria: A deliberately drifting figure fails check with a useful message.

title: integrate: methods, until, output record
description: auto (symplectic if pairs else rk4), symplectic Euler, verlet (separability check → E605), rk4, midpoint, euler (only by name), implicit_euler (Newton, ≤8 iters); `until` with crossing interpolation; record t/vars/n/at()/last/invariant/drift/stopped; step limit E607.
acceptance_criteria: Harmonic oscillator: symplectic/verlet energy within 1% over 10k steps, rk4 within 0.1%, euler drifts (§21.4).

title: Compute node framework
description: `compute:` section, records with field access, bound names inside nodes, caching by dependency, per-node cost reported by `check`.
acceptance_criteria: A node not reading x is not recomputed when x moves (test).

title: Browser benchmark harness (replaces M0's Node projection)
description: Headless Chromium/Firefox/WebKit (Playwright) timing interaction frames of corpus figures at 1280/390 px, light/dark; record p95; first-frame ink check. Measures the real wasm penalty and decides whether M0's Canvas2D deferral holds.
acceptance_criteria: Numbers for every M2 figure in a bench report; budget misses filed as issues.

title: Dragging with pointer formulas
description: drag maps value names to formulas over pointer/start/anchor0/delta/at; automatic relative drag for point values; hit testing in hapto geometry (12 px mouse, 22 px touch, topmost z); keyboard nudges through the same formulas; pointer capture; touch scroll preserved.
acceptance_criteria: A point on a curve stays on the curve under mouse, touch and keyboard.

title: Prose bindings: set, show, mark, when
description: data-hapto-set (hover preview, click/tap/Enter commit), -show (live textContent, format), -mark, -when; reference syntax fig.name with ambiguity errors; literal syntax; classes; focusable with aria-description.
acceptance_criteria: A hand-written HTML page using only §15.4 attributes works end to end.

title: Page state store, shared values, URL persistence
description: Main-thread authoritative store; page-level values (<script data-hapto-page>), `uses` imports and renames, `shared: true`, coalesced sets per animation frame, persist: url fragment, <hapto-controls for>, <hapto-reset>.
acceptance_criteria: Two figures importing `t` stay in sync; URL round-trips non-default values.

title: Controls per value type, layout, keyboard
description: slider/stepper/input/reroll, buttons/dropdown, handle+hidden inputs, toggle/checkbox, none; marks on sliders; columns/side/groups layout; keyboard rules incl. log decades; aria-valuetext with units; W301 surfaced in dev mode.
acceptance_criteria: Every value reachable by keyboard; screen-reader smoke test.

title: Render worker, OffscreenCanvas, latest-state-wins, DPR, progressive quality
description: Worker owns wasm; OffscreenCanvas path and ImageBitmap/RGBA fallback (both required); one render in flight per figure; DPR cap 2; half-res while dragging when over budget, full-res 150 ms after input; ResizeObserver; readouts posted before raster.
acceptance_criteria: Both rendering paths tested; dragging never queues stale frames.

title: hapto.js: <hapto-figure>, lifecycle, lazy loading, fallbacks
description: Light-DOM custom element (§15.2) with attributes; lifecycle of §15.3 (reserve box, IntersectionObserver, release far-off surfaces); fallback image until first frame; one wasm module for all figures; `src` YAML/JSON or inline script.
acceptance_criteria: No layout shift on load; a 30-figure page stays within the memory budget.

title: legacy preset: 1.0 BookFigure specs keep working
description: Documents without `hapto:` and kind plot/columns translate to `preset: legacy`, generate alt, gain ticks/labels, otherwise draw what 1.0 drew; W801 deprecation.
acceptance_criteria: Every spec hmu currently emits renders; parity looked at against 1.0 PNGs.

title: hapto-web 2.0 surface
description: Figure.load, values, setState, resize(css,dpr), evaluate (readouts, prose lets, alt), render (RGBA / OffscreenCanvas), underlay, renderSVG, hitTest, drag (§15.10). Register baked maths on load.
acceptance_criteria: Node-level tests of each call; wasm stays typst-free.
notes: Carry-over from M1-eval (hapto-p0n.6): verify native and wasm evaluation are digit-identical on a sample of formulas (transcendental functions via libm, rand, OKLab mix). M1 had no wasm runner; this surface's Node tests are the first place it can run.

acceptance_criteria: All pass `hapto check` and §21 natively; PNGs looked at.

acceptance_criteria: Both pass `hapto check` and §21 natively; side-by-side look with the baseline.

acceptance_criteria: Used by every M2 corpus figure.

acceptance_criteria: Each command used on the M2 corpus in CI.

acceptance_criteria: Each kind ink-tested; signed area distinguishes sign without colour.

acceptance_criteria: Each kind has an ink test and a looked-at PNG.

acceptance_criteria: tan(x) draws without vertical joins; 1/x breaks at 0; sampling bounded.

description: text mark (anchor ×9+baseline, offset px, size px, weight, rotate, max_width, background), math mark, inline $…$; interpolation {expr:spec} outside TeX only (E107 inside); label anchors per kind (§10.3); minimum collision avoidance; 11 px floor; W602 above 60 labels.
acceptance_criteria: Maths renders from baked layouts at two widths; E107 tested; label collision demo looked at.

title: Views: mapping, equal aspect, axes modes, padding

acceptance_criteria: A circle stays a circle at three sizes; each axes mode rendered and looked at.
close_reason: Views: grid cells, padding, linear/log mapping, equal aspect (3 sizes tested), size rules, six axes modes + grid (rendered and looked at), clipping.

title: Style, theme tokens and colour scales
description: Tokens of §9.1 light/dark (Okabe–Ito; contrast-checked), style keys as formulas (width named/px, dash patterns, opacity, halo), kind defaults (§9.4), highlight style, colour scales sequential/diverging/cyclic/categorical in OKLab, page CSS overrides for accent/bg.
acceptance_criteria: Tokens meet WCAG AA against bg in both themes (test); a width formula renders (thickness lesson).

title: Scene builder: literal kinemo scenes, units, theme background
description: Evaluate Program → kinemo Scene with literal props each change (no reconciler, per M0). frame_w=16, frame_h=16·H/W; unit conversions of §7.3 (stroke ×1080/H, text ×16/W); fill_opacity default fixed; presence set; config.background = theme bg (M0 finding).
acceptance_criteria: Ink test: default render ≥0.5% painted in light and dark; non-16:9 sizes fill without letterbox.
close_reason: Scene builder with M0 unit conversions, theme background, presence/fill fixes; end-to-end render; ink >=0.5% light and dark; square canvas fills (tested); render example.

title: Values and state 2.0
description: Four value types with declarations of §5.2; admission (clamp → snap → clamp; choice refused; wrong type refused) returning {applied, clamped}; continuous step = range/1000; log scale semantics (§5.4); reserved state focus/theme; E5xx.
acceptance_criteria: Admission matrix tested; the 1.0 coarse-slider guard ported and tightened.
close_reason: State 2.0 with admission (clamp/snap/refuse, clamped flag), reset, reserved focus/theme; tested incl. ported slider guard.

title: Compile a document into a typed Program
description: Document + hapto-expr → Program: every formula type-checked against its field type (§4.7), dependency graph from values to lets/marks, stable mark keys (path + repeat indices).
acceptance_criteria: A change to one value re-evaluates only its dependent marks (test).
close_reason: Program: typed slots with context-bound names, drag/tangent checks, per-mark deps (tested: a change reaches only its marks).

title: Figure document model and strict validation
description: serde model for §6 (JSON and YAML 1.2), single-view shorthand vs views (E406), literal-or-formula fields, unknown keys refused with edit-distance suggestions (E401), `colour`/`color` alias, required keys (E402/E403), `hapto: 2` versioning and missing-version rule (E407), one kind key per mark (E408), unknown view (E409).
acceptance_criteria: Every E4xx tested; JSON Schema generated from the model.
close_reason: Document model: strict decoding with paths and suggestions; values/views/marks/readouts/size/layout/uses/controls; all E4xx tested; JSON Schema generated from the decoder tables.

title: Spike: how to subset kinemo's embedded fonts
description: DejaVu Sans ×3 + Mono are 1.03 MB of the 1.29 MB brotli bundle. Options: subset the TTFs in kinemo-text (pin bump), or a font-override hook in kinemo-text so hapto supplies subset faces. Measure brotli after subsetting to Latin, Latin-1, Greek, math operators, arrows; check whether bold/oblique/mono are reachable from the format.
acceptance_criteria: Recommendation with measured sizes; follow-up task updated.

title: typeset feature on hapto-core and maths baking
description: Workspace `kinemo-math` with default-features=false; hapto-core feature `typeset` (on for the CLI, off for hapto-web). Baking: record layouts natively (kinemo_math::baked::start_recording/recorded) into the document's `baked` key; register in wasm. Always lay out at size 1 and scale at draw time (baked keys include size). Unbaked TeX in the browser → E608. Replaces the M0 dev-dependency (see H2).
acceptance_criteria: `cargo tree -p hapto-web --target wasm32` has no typst; a baked document renders identical maths in wasm and native at two figure widths.

title: Error object and human rendering
description: Error shape of §18.1 (code, severity, message, path, formula, span, hint, options, figure, source) with caret rendering; stable codes; catalogue entries for E1xx–E3xx.
acceptance_criteria: Each E1xx–E3xx has a test asserting code, span and hint text.
close_reason: Error rendering with caret; catalogue with examples; every E1xx–E3xx example tested for code, span and hint.

title: Static dependency graph and incremental re-evaluation
description: From each value to every let (and later compute node and mark) that reads it, transitively. API: given a changed value set, re-evaluate only what depends on it; cache the rest.
acceptance_criteria: Test: changing x re-evaluates exactly the dependents of x (counted).
close_reason: Transitive deps per let and per formula; Cache::invalidate recomputes exactly the dependents (counted in tests).

title: Evaluator with no-value semantics and fuel
description: Native evaluation over the typed AST; runtime failures produce no value (§4.8) instead of panics; an operation budget (fuel) per evaluation (E604, 50M ops default); deterministic across native and wasm.
acceptance_criteria: No-value propagation tested for each failure kind; fuel exhaustion tested; native/wasm digit-identical on a sample.
close_reason: Evaluator with no-value semantics, fuel (E604), let cache; native/wasm digit check carried to hapto-hl7.1 (no wasm runner before M3).

title: Type checker
description: Types num, bool, str, vec, colour, list<T>, mat, records. The list-or-vec rule for `[a, b]`; no implicit conversions; the operator table of §4.3 (vec*vec is E204 with dot/cross/cmul hint). E2xx with found/expected types and mechanical fixes.
acceptance_criteria: Every row of the §4.3 tables and every E2xx tested.
close_reason: Checker with typed IR, overloads, coercions; every operator-table row and E2xx tested.

title: Name resolution, scope and lets
description: Lookup order of §4.4 (bound vars → lets → compute → values → imported values); bound variables may shadow, nothing else may (E303); reserved words (E302); lets ordered by dependency with cycle report (E304); user functions `f(x)` with inferred parameter types; recursion ban (E305); functions passable only to calculus builtins.
acceptance_criteria: Every E3xx tested; `explain` data (what each name resolved to) available.
close_reason: Module: names validated, lets ordered, cycles/recursion refused with paths, functions monomorphised; every E3xx tested.

title: Parser for Appendix B, with spans and a printer
description: Precedence and associativity of §4.3 (non-associative comparisons → E105, right-assoc `**`, `-x**2 == -(x**2)`), if-then-else, calls, index, field, list literals, comprehensions with `if`, generator arguments. AST carries spans; a printer emits canonical text.
acceptance_criteria: Property test: print(parse(s)) re-parses to the same AST. E101/E104/E105 tested.
close_reason: Parser + printer; round-trip property test (2000 cases) and E101/E103/E104/E105 tests.

title: Lexer with spans and refused tokens
description: Numbers, both string quote styles, booleans, colours, identifiers, operators, keywords. Lex `^`, implicit multiplication (`2x`), non-ASCII operators (`x²`) and comma decimals only to produce E102/E103/E106 with hints.
acceptance_criteria: Every token kind and every refusal tested with its hint text.
close_reason: Lexer with spans; every refusal tested with its hint.

title: Create the hapto-expr crate
description: New workspace member `crates/hapto-expr`, no kinemo dependency, `libm` for transcendental functions (determinism §3.5), serde for spans/errors.
acceptance_criteria: Crate builds on native and wasm32; CI runs its tests.
close_reason: Crate added; builds natively and for wasm32 (CI job 'hapto-expr on wasm32').

title: Decide: keep kinemo-math (typst) as a dev-dependency, or gate the M0 math workload behind a feature
description: M0 added kinemo-math as a dev-dependency so the benchmark can typeset TeX. The wasm build stays typst-free, but Cargo.lock grew ~2.3k lines and CI (clippy --all-targets, tests) now compiles typst. Superseded once M2 adds the `typeset` feature; decide whether to accept the CI cost until then.
acceptance_criteria: Decision recorded in this issue; Cargo.toml matches it.
close_reason: Decided: keep kinemo-math as a dev-dependency until M2-typeset (hapto-mn2.1) replaces it with a typeset feature. A temporary feature just for the M0 benchmark would be thrown away soon after; the cost is CI compiling typst for tests/clippy until then. The wasm build is unaffected (no typst in hapto-web's wasm tree).

close_reason: M1 done: hapto-expr has lexer, parser (round-trip property test), type checker with typed IR, module (lets, functions, cycles), evaluator with no-value and fuel, incremental deps, full §4.6 stdlib and error catalogue. 121 tests.

title: Runtime accessibility basics
description: Interpolated alt as canvas aria-label (throttled 1/s while dragging), aria-live only on readouts, 44 px targets, reduced motion respected.
acceptance_criteria: axe-core clean on the M3 example page.

title: Print, no-JS, dev mode, errors on the page
description: beforeprint swaps touched figures for current-state SVG; noscript fallback; devMode (numeric failures, invariants, timings overlay, inline binding errors); a failed load keeps the fallback and shows the code.
acceptance_criteria: Print preview of a touched figure shows its current state.

title: Play and reset
description: Play/pause for number values (duration, loop once/wrap/bounce) driven by requestAnimationFrame from the page; pauses on interaction and off-screen; no autoplay; reset per figure and per page.
acceptance_criteria: The engine never advances time (test: no clock reads in core).

title: JavaScript API, events and styling hooks
description: ready, values, set/setMany ({applied, clamped}), get, readouts, reset, focusMark, toSVG, toPNG, hapto:change (source), hapto:error; hapto.page; hapto.css with custom properties only; theme detection.
acceptance_criteria: API documented with examples; a theme switch re-renders.

title: Focus linking between marks and prose
description: name/group focusable; hover in figure sets focus and lights prose (hapto-lit); prose mark binding sets focus; highlight style and dim_others; focus readable in formulas.
acceptance_criteria: Two-way hover demo looked at.

title: CLI: hapto bake
description: Typeset every TeX string of a document natively and write it back with its `baked` layouts, for pages outside hapto-book.
acceptance_criteria: A baked document renders maths in the browser build; an unbaked one fails with E608.

title: Marks: rect, box, groups and transforms
description: rect (corner or two corners), box with text sizing (§8.4); group with translate/rotate/scale/origin, inherited view/when (§8.14).
acceptance_criteria: Rotated group keeps px widths unscaled (test).

title: Readouts
description: id, label (TeX), value (num/str/bool), format, unit, compare, place below/inside/none; no value prints —.
acceptance_criteria: Readout and drawing read the same formula (test with a shared let).

title: Ticks and axis labels
description: auto (1/2/5×10^k at ~80 px, 60 on phones), numeric step, list, at+labels, pi ticks with TeX labels, log decades with minors; overlap dropping; axis labels with TeX.
acceptance_criteria: No overlapping labels across a sweep of sizes; pi ticks render as TeX.

title: Subset fonts (target ≤ 0.5 MB brotli)
description: Implement the spike's recommendation; pin bump if it is a kinemo change (separate commit there).
acceptance_criteria: hapto.wasm brotli ≤ 0.8 MB; text in corpus renders unchanged.

title: Stdlib: probability, randomness, colour, format
description: §4.6.9–11: counter-based rand(seed,i) (SplitMix64, 53 bits), randn, samples_normal/uniform, normal_pdf/cdf, binom_pmf, poisson_pmf, choose, factorial (≤170); rgb rgba hsl palette mix (OKLab) with_alpha colour_scale; format with Python format specs.
acceptance_criteria: rand reproducible across native/wasm; OKLab mix matches kinemo's Mix on samples; format specs tested.
close_reason: Probability, seeded randomness, colours/scales, Python format specs; tested (moments, closed forms, round trips).

title: Stdlib: matrices and complex numbers
description: §4.6.7–8: mat construct, M[i][j], M*v, M*N, M**k, transpose det inverse (singular → no value) trace identity rows cols col row; eig for 2×2 (real/complex record); cmul cdiv conj cabs carg cexp cpow cpolar.
acceptance_criteria: Each tested incl. singular and complex-eigenvalue cases.
close_reason: Matrix and complex stdlib; eig incl. complex, shear and diagonal cases; tested.

title: Stdlib: calculus
description: §4.6.6: derivative (central, h=1e-5·max(1,|x|)), derivative2, integral (adaptive Simpson 1e-9, depth 30, reversed bounds), roots (512-scan + Brent 1e-12, sorted), argmin/argmax (scan + golden section), newton_step. All take a user function name.
acceptance_criteria: Tested against closed forms (§21.4); tangential-root limitation documented.
close_reason: Calculus stdlib tested against closed forms; tangential-root limitation documented and tested.

title: Stdlib: lists, comprehensions, reductions, histogram
description: §4.6.5: comprehensions (+ filter), generator forms of sum/prod/min/max/mean/count, range (end-exclusive), linspace, count, index, first/last, cumsum, diffs, zip, xs_of/ys_of, sort, reverse, interp, histogram record. Length limit 100 000.
acceptance_criteria: Each tested; limit enforced.
close_reason: List stdlib with length limit through the budget; tested.

title: Stdlib: vectors and geometry
description: §4.6.4: vec .x .y norm dist dot cross unit perp rotate(±about) angle angle_between polar mid proj reflect intersect circle_through.
acceptance_criteria: Each tested, incl. degenerate inputs (zero vector, parallel lines → no value).
close_reason: Vector/geometry stdlib with degenerate cases as no value; tested.

title: Stdlib: constants, arithmetic, trigonometry
description: §4.6.1–§4.6.3: pi tau e; abs sign floor ceil trunc round(x[,d]) min/max variadic clamp lerp remap sqrt cbrt hypot exp ln log10 log2 log num int; sin…tanh atan2 deg to_deg wrap. `%` is mathematical modulo.
acceptance_criteria: Each function tested incl. zero, negative, huge, no-value.
close_reason: Basic stdlib complete with tests incl. edge cases; OKLab colour mixing.

title: Grow CI with the new crates and gates
description: Add hapto-expr/hapto-book to CI; `hapto check` on the corpus; golden comparison; `hapto bench` regression (>20% p95 fails); `hapto book check` on the demo book; nightly browser matrix. Grows milestone by milestone (§21.7).
acceptance_criteria: CI runs every gate of §21.7.

title: M8 — Hardening and 2.0 release
description: Accessibility audit, browser matrix, performance on the reference phone, complete error catalogue, reference docs, format frozen at `hapto: 2`.
acceptance_criteria: §22 complete (32 corpus figures + demo book). Tag 2.0.

title: M6 — Several views and presets
description: Multi-view layout, phone stacking, connectors, polar views; all presets with `hapto expand`.
acceptance_criteria: b-unit-circle, b-phasor, b-transform pass; every corpus figure with a preset form rewritten with it, goldens identical to the expanded form.

title: M7 — hapto-book
description: Book source format, prose maths, bindings validated at build time, tasks, progress, navigation, en/pt strings, serve. hmu emits book source instead of HTML.
acceptance_criteria: The demo book (§22.3) builds and passes `hapto book check`; an hmu-generated book builds with hapto-book.

title: M5 — Fields and structures
description: heatmap as raster underlay (browser-composited), contours, vector_field, streamlines under the batching rule; matrix; graph.
acceptance_criteria: a-phase, a-skew, a-atoms, a-motor, a-laplacian, a-ports, a-coenergy, b-field-lines, b-gradient-descent, b-pendulum, b-epsilon-delta pass §21; heavy figures meet the heavy budget.

title: M4 — Computation
description: integrate, iterate, sample, randomness, invariant checks; data marks; repeat; play wired to time values.
acceptance_criteria: a-passive, a-caps, a-integrators, b-damped-oscillator, b-projectile, b-newton, b-normal-samples, b-clt, b-fourier, b-riemann, b-taylor, b-regression pass §21.

title: Polar views
description: coords: polar with circular grid and spokes, r(θ) functions, always equal aspect.
acceptance_criteria: A cardioid renders; ticks are sensible.

title: Remove 1.0-only code paths once their replacements land
description: book.rs, demos.rs, Figure::bind_free/from_json, Build's Expr-binding plumbing and BookFigure are replaced by the rebuild model, presets and the corpus. Delete after the legacy preset (M3) and corpus figures exist, keeping tests that still encode real lessons (pixel-count, step granularity).
acceptance_criteria: No 1.0-only module left; every 1.0 test either ported or removed with a reason.

title: Progressive hints and solutions for tasks?
description: SPEC-2.0 §26. Default: One hint: in 2.0; solution: reserved. Revisit only with evidence from real books.

title: Standalone HTML export of a figure (blogs, slides)?
description: SPEC-2.0 §26. Default: Yes via `hapto render --html`, after M8 unless it falls out earlier. Revisit only with evidence from real books.

title: Box/port auto-layout for diagram-heavy chapters?
description: SPEC-2.0 §26. Default: No; explicit positions with repeat and lets. Revisit only with evidence from real books.

title: Search across the book?
description: SPEC-2.0 §26. Default: Not in 2.0; 2.1. Revisit only with evidence from real books.

title: Should page values support persist: local?
description: SPEC-2.0 §26. Default: No in 2.0; url only. Revisit only with evidence from real books.

title: Deferred decisions (post-2.0 or when evidence arrives)
description: Open questions 6–10 of SPEC-2.0 §26, each with a default so no work is blocked.
